label: Generation Area (ICS515 SAT)
info:
Reads and writes the Generation-area points on the CLICK PLC over Modbus TCP.
Edit the 'Gen PLC' Modbus client config node (double-click any Modbus-Read/Write node, then the pencil next to Server) and set tcpHost to your PLC's real IP address before deploying.

label: Generation Area (ICS515 SAT)
info:
Reads and writes the Generation-area points on the CLICK PLC over Modbus TCP.
Edit the 'Gen PLC' Modbus client config node (double-click any Modbus-Read/Write node, then the pencil next to Server) and set tcpHost to your PLC's real IP address before deploying.

label: Transmission Area (ICS515 SAT)
info:
Reads and writes the Transmission-area points on the CLICK PLC over Modbus TCP.
This flow reuses the 'Gen PLC' Modbus client config node created by the Generation flow (same physical PLC, same connection) - deploy the Generation flow first, or point the nodes here at your own client config node.

label: Distribution Residential Area (ICS515 SAT)
info:
Reads and writes the Distribution Residential points on the CLICK PLC over Modbus TCP.
Reuses the 'Gen PLC' Modbus client config node - deploy the Generation flow first.
No_Board_Present_Run_Sim and ProtoType_Pot_BW are shown as live switches for visibility/override, but since a physical load potentiometer is wired to this board, leave No_Board_Present_Run_Sim OFF so the ladder uses the real DF1 reading instead of a fixed simulated value.

label: Distribution Industrial Area (ICS515 SAT)
info:
Reads and writes the Distribution Industrial points on the CLICK PLC over Modbus TCP.
Reuses the 'Gen PLC' Modbus client config node - deploy the Generation flow first.
Industrial load = 20% base (from the physical load pot, DF2) + 40% per Arc Furnace turned on. Requires Generation AND Transmission both alive before load is calculated.

label: Historian (InfluxDB)
info:
Independent, slower Modbus polling (5s) that feeds InfluxDB 1.x for trending/Grafana.
Reuses the 'Gen PLC' Modbus client config node - deploy the Generation flow first so that node exists, or re-point these Read nodes at your own client.

Before deploying, create the target database on the InfluxDB 1.6.4 instance, e.g.:
  curl.exe -i -XPOST http://10.3.0.60:8086/query --data-urlencode "q=CREATE DATABASE ics515_sat"

This flow intentionally runs on its own 5s cycle, separate from the 1s HMI dashboard reads, since a historian doesn't need control-loop speed and this keeps the added PLC/network load small.

NOTE ON TOPOLOGY: this flow has Node-RED (in the DMZ) opening an outbound write connection into InfluxDB sitting on the PCN. That's backwards from the usual pattern (historian at the boundary, control software deepest in the trusted zone). Fine for this lab, but flag it if you carry this design into a real segmented network - normally the historian/data-diode direction should be PCN -> DMZ, not DMZ reaching back into the PCN.
